description: This Java class provides logic to find ranges of differences between two ConfigurationImage objects, in order to generate diffs for ECU updates.

classes.name: ConfigurationImageDiff
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for computing differences between configuration images used in ECU firmware updates.

methods.name: findDifferences
methods.description: Finds the range of differences between two ConfigurationImage instances starting from a given position; returns null if there are no differences.
